title: Unholy
summary: UNHO'LY, adjective 1. Not holy; not renewed and sanctified. 2 Timothy 3:2. 2. Profane; not hallowed; not consecrated; common. Hebrews 10:29. 3. Impious; wicked. 4. Not ceremonially purified. Leviticus
